parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.company, c.job_title, c.lead_score, c.lead_status, c.source, c.tags, c.custom_fields, c.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id) as total_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_opened') as emails_opened, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_clicked') as emails_clicked, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'page_view') as page_views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type IN ('meeting_scheduled', 'demo_completed')) as meetings, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.deal_value), 0) FROM deals d WHERE d.contact_id = c.id AND d.stage = 'closed_won') as lifetime_value FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status NOT IN ('lost') AND c.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days' ORDER BY c.lead_score DESC LIMIT 500

{{ $json.segments.map(s => s.contact_ids.length > 0 ? `UPDATE contacts SET tags = array_append(COALESCE(tags, ARRAY[]::text[]), 'segment:${s.segment}') WHERE id IN (${s.contact_ids.join(',')}) AND NOT ('segment:${s.segment}' = ANY(COALESCE(tags, ARRAY[]::text[])))` : 'SELECT 1').join('; ') }}
